The '''Iska system''' was located in the [[Iska sector/Legends|Iska sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Iska pirates/Legends|Iska pirates]].<ref name="EGTW" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the [[Star system/Legends|system]] fell within the territory held by [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Iska system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-17.<ref name="TEA" />
